sources.title: Tandem-GMAW: advanced pulsed and short-circuiting process mode experimental data
sources.sample_count_label: 30 layer metadata rows; 5 workpieces x 6 layers
known_limitations: No NDT disposition established by this source admission
L1 is single-wire root; L2-L6 tandem
Five t8/5 records unavailable and preserved as missing

sources.title: Intel Robotic Welding Multimodal Dataset
known_limitations: Dataset card reports labels may be noisy and not expert post-weld validated
A sample may contain multiple defects
Scripted simultaneous trigger does not eliminate sensor/device response misalignment

sources.title: Dataset for estimating reinforcement, width and penetration of the weld bead in the GMAW process using thermographic information
sources.publisher: Data in Brief / University of Brasília authors
known_limitations: Article licence is CC BY-NC; dataset item licence requires separate read-back
Penetration labels are macrographic/destructive section measurements, not NDT
Not a shipyard multi-pass T-GMAW domain

split_policy.rule: group by highest physical common identity; preserve all nested observations within the group

controls.mutation: Register the three pinned dataset metadata cards without downloading or vendoring any raw source files; preserve distinct rights and label authority.
controls.rationale: The baseline admits metadata and provenance only.

controls.mutation: Apply the BAM article's CC BY-4.0 licence to the separate Zenodo raw archive.
controls.rationale: Article text/metadata and raw archive have distinct rights records.

controls.mutation: Train or use a commercial Luminous production model with the Intel research-use-only non-commercial dataset.
controls.rationale: The Intel Research Use License limits use to research and is not a commercial grant.

controls.mutation: Treat gated Intel data as unrestricted public data without accepting the access terms.
controls.rationale: Gated access and licence acceptance must be explicit.

controls.mutation: Assume the GMAW Figshare file licence is CC BY-NC solely from the article copyright notice.
controls.rationale: Item/version-level terms must be read from the actual data record.

controls.mutation: Download any raw files while the source rights state is pending or incompatible with the declared purpose.
controls.rationale: Metadata-only source registration is the allowed current state.

controls.mutation: Copy restricted or rights-pending raw files into the public repository.
controls.rationale: Raw data are not vendored in this benchmark.

controls.mutation: Replace an explicitly versioned DOI with a mutable latest-version URI without pinning the resolved version.
controls.rationale: The exact source version is part of provenance.

controls.mutation: Split BAM layers randomly across train and test despite only five WIDs.
controls.rationale: All observations from a WID remain within one split.

controls.mutation: Split Intel video frames or windows from one welding session across train and test.
controls.rationale: Group by session/weld identity.

controls.mutation: Split rows from one thermography experiment run across train and test.
controls.rationale: Group by full experiment run.

controls.mutation: Count millions of time samples or frames as independent physical specimens.
controls.rationale: Sampling density does not increase independent unit count.

controls.mutation: Treat Intel intended defect-category annotations as expert-verified defect truth.
controls.rationale: Dataset card reports labels may be noisy and lack expert post-weld validation.

controls.mutation: Force a potentially multi-defect Intel weld into a mutually exclusive single-label truth.
controls.rationale: Preserve multi-label and uncertain-label semantics.

controls.mutation: Promote Intel intended defect categories to independent UT/RT/PAUT inspection results.
controls.rationale: No traceable NDT finding is established by the dataset card.

controls.mutation: Treat macrographic penetration profile as nondestructive testing acceptance.
controls.rationale: Macrograph is destructive section-specific measurement.

controls.mutation: Infer fusion, penetration acceptance or defect absence from current/voltage alone.
controls.rationale: Process observations are not direct quality or NDT ground truth.

controls.mutation: Pool intended defect categories, macrograph measurements and NDT labels into one common accuracy denominator.
controls.rationale: Targets and label authority differ.

controls.mutation: Resample all modalities to one frequency and discard their original sampling intervals.
controls.rationale: Native sample cadence and timestamps remain separate.

controls.mutation: Treat simultaneous trigger script as proof of a zero-offset common clock.
controls.rationale: Sensor response and device clock differences must be measured.

controls.mutation: Ignore sensor/device response latency when aligning audio, video and electrical signals.
controls.rationale: Clock offset and response delay are separate quantities.

controls.mutation: Interpolate across a missing block and record the interpolated sample as measured.
controls.rationale: Missingness remains explicit unless a declared transform permits imputation.

controls.mutation: Convert missing timestamp, unit or sensor channel to numeric zero.
controls.rationale: Unknown is not zero.

controls.mutation: Predict defect annotations from a feature computed using the same label/post-weld image without declaring target leakage.
controls.rationale: Inputs and labels require provenance and leakage controls.

controls.mutation: Use sample_id instead of physical session/specimen identity as the split group.
controls.rationale: The highest shared physical grouping level governs split isolation.

controls.mutation: Treat the five BAM WIDs as five replicated examples per process-mode class.
controls.rationale: Some modes have only one independent WID; report the actual group count.

controls.mutation: Claim causal PMC/CMT superiority from the single BAM matched workpiece pair.
controls.rationale: One WID per mode is exploratory, not replicated causal evidence.

controls.mutation: Compare laser scan width with macrograph penetration as if they were the same measured output.
controls.rationale: Different modalities and physical scopes require distinct targets.

controls.mutation: Report point accuracy without uncertainty or calibration by domain.
controls.rationale: Calibration/coverage and per-domain intervals are required.

controls.mutation: Claim leave-one-domain-out success across targets that are not physically or semantically matched.
controls.rationale: Transfer results require matched output definitions.

controls.mutation: Merge automotive, lab-flat GMAW and shipyard tandem-GMAW domains into a single process identity.
controls.rationale: Material, joint, process, position and equipment domain remain explicit.

controls.mutation: Drop failed or poor samples from a benchmark without reporting the selection rule and denominator.
controls.rationale: Selection and exclusions must be disclosed.

controls.mutation: Release model weights, embeddings or feature stores derived from Intel material without checking the licence and distribution conditions.
controls.rationale: Training-derived artefacts can retain licence obligations.

controls.mutation: Retain Intel source material or derivatives after a license termination/deletion obligation applies.
controls.rationale: Rights and retention lifecycle must be represented.

controls.mutation: Use a third-party mirror as the authoritative dataset source without matching the pinned record digest.
controls.rationale: Official source/version and file digests are required.

controls.mutation: Publish derived features without source digest, transform revision, configuration, units and output digest.
controls.rationale: Every derivative must be reproducible.

controls.mutation: Treat a video/audio anomaly score as a verified weld-quality finding.
controls.rationale: Weak signals remain advisory labels unless independently validated.

controls.mutation: Label an uninspected weld as defect-free.
controls.rationale: Absence of an inspection label is not a negative label.

controls.mutation: Use post-repair or post-NDT outcomes as input features for an earlier prediction timestamp.
controls.rationale: Future outcome leakage is prohibited.

controls.mutation: Include duplicated clips or repeated augmentations across train and test.
controls.rationale: Duplicate/near-duplicate source group identity must be retained.

controls.mutation: Transfer an Intel non-commercial trained model into a commercial use case without a distinct permission basis.
controls.rationale: Commercial downstream rights are not granted by the Intel research licence.
